name: nav-drawer
title: Nav Drawer
author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>
description: O menu mobile feito uma vez direito: foco preso, Escape, retorno do foco e trava de rolagem vindos do Radix Dialog; entrada em cascata com teto, e ícone que lê o estado em vez de guardar o seu.

.nav-drawer-overlay[data-state=closed].animation: nav-drawer-veil var(--dur-fast, 140ms) var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1)) reverse both

.nav-drawer-panel[data-side=right][data-.animation: nav-drawer-from-right var(--dur-base, 240ms) var(--ease-drawer, cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)) reverse both

.nav-drawer-panel[data-side=left][data-s.animation: nav-drawer-from-left var(--dur-base, 240ms) var(--ease-drawer, cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)) reverse both

.nav-drawer-panel[data-side=top][data-st.animation: nav-drawer-from-top var(--dur-base, 240ms) var(--ease-drawer, cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)) reverse both
